attempts.Message: A treatment plan's patient and origin never change.
Treatment plans are never deleted; a plan that should not stand is withdrawn with a reason.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanRevisions] SET [ClinicalRationale] = LEFT(N'overwritten by the Gate C attempt', 33) WHERE [ClinicalRationale] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: A saved revision of a treatment plan is never edited or deleted; a change saves the next revision.
A saved revision of a treatment plan is never edited or deleted; a change saves the next revision.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanRevisionPhases] SET [Name] = LEFT(N'overwritten by the Gate C attempt', 33) WHERE [Name] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: The phases of a saved revision are never edited or deleted.
The phases of a saved revision are never edited or deleted.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanRevisionItems] SET [PhaseNumber] = [PhaseNumber] + 1 WHERE [PhaseNumber] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: The procedures of a saved revision are never edited or deleted.
The procedures of a saved revision are never edited or deleted.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanEvents] SET [Title] = LEFT(N'overwritten by the Gate C attempt', 33) WHERE [Title] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: The history of a treatment plan is append-only.
The history of a treatment plan is append-only.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanItems] SET [Fee] = [Fee] + 1 WHERE [Fee] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: A treatment plan item is never edited; withdraw it with a reason and add the correct one.
Treatment plan items are never deleted; a wrong item is withdrawn with a reason.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanItemStates] SET [Reason] = LEFT(N'overwritten by the Gate C attempt', 33) WHERE [Reason] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: The history of a procedure's acceptance, scheduling and completion is append-only.
The history of a procedure's acceptance, scheduling and completion is append-only.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [CompletedProcedures] SET [ToothKey] = [ToothKey] + 1 WHERE [ToothKey] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: A completed procedure is finalized when it is created; correct it with an amendment, never by changing or deleting it.
A completed procedure is finalized when it is created; correct it with an amendment, never by changing or deleting it.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [CompletionSets] SET [IdempotencyKey] = LEFT(N'overwritten by the Gate C attempt', 33) WHERE [IdempotencyKey] IS NOT NULL
attempts.Message: A completion set is append-only; it is never changed or deleted.
A completion set is append-only; it is never changed or deleted.

attempts.Statement: UPDATE [TreatmentPlanItems] SET [WithdrawnAtUtc] = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET(), [WithdrawnByUserId] = (SELECT TOP 1 [Id] FROM [UserAccounts]), [WithdrawnReason] = N'overwritten by the Gate C attempt' WHERE [Id] IN (SELECT [PlanItemId] FROM [CompletedProcedures])
attempts.Message: A completed procedure cannot be withdrawn.

sanctionedPaths: treatment plan: a revision is the sanctioned path (the plan is now at revision 2; earlier revisions are kept)
completed procedure: a correction is an amendment, appended and never an edit; the completed-procedure rows were byte for byte unchanged by it
